answer_1.quote: Automatic story generation poses a significant challenge... We conduct an empirical comparison between GPT-3 and other SOTA techniques for open‑ended story generation on three different corpora...

answer_2.quote: We use two types of automatic evaluation metrics: 1) reference-based metrics, where we compare the generated stories to human reference stories... 2) reference‑free metrics, where we assess the quality of the stories directly.

answer_4.quote: We first collect human judgements using the Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) platform... We also recruit university volunteers to collect in‑house judgements. We ask them to evaluate the same 5 aspects using the same scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each story on fluency, coherence, relatedness, logicality, and interestingness on a 1‑5 ordinal scale.
